svg.title: I for Infographic Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. The original I and pen-nib motif transforms into charts, a trend line and a donut graph, then reveals infographic design examples for charts, process and reports. Charts are decorative and do not represent actual statistics.
svg.metadata: 16:9; 1920 by 1080; 6.5-second loop; derived from 09_I_illustration.png; visualizations are illustrative; no external assets.

g.text: MAKE COMPLEX INFORMATION EASY TO SEE.
